feature_definitions.name: hist_wr_diff
feature_definitions.definition: Blue minus red win rate over all earlier games, shrunk: (wins+2.5)/(n+5)

feature_definitions.name: experience_diff
feature_definitions.definition: Blue minus red log(1 + number of earlier games)

feature_definitions.name: elo_diff_x_intl
feature_definitions.definition: elo_diff times 1 if the league is a tier-1 international event (Worlds, MSI, First Stand, Esports World Cup)
